title: Total Lipid Extraction from Baker's Yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae)
author: Israel Olayide
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b4h8qt9w

steps.title: Prepare Yeast Plates
steps.instruction: Streak a plate from a prepared glycerol stock (-80 °C) and spread on a YPD agar plate.

steps.title: Incubate Yeast Colonies
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 25-30 °C for 2-3 days until colonies 1-2 mm in diameter have formed.

steps.title: Inoculate YPD Medium
steps.instruction: Inoculate 5 mL of YPD with a yeast colony from the plate using a sterile loop.

substeps.instruction: Sterilize the inoculating loop by dipping it in ethanol and heating it in a flame for 30 seconds.
Allow the loop to cool for at least 10 seconds.

steps.title: Grow Yeast Culture
steps.instruction: Grow the culture overnight at 30°C with shaking at 250 rpm.

steps.title: Harvest Yeast Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest the whole cells once the OD 600 reaches 1.5.

substeps.instruction: Check OD 600 using a UV-Vis spectrophotometer.
Centrifuge at 1000 x g for 2 minutes (or until clear) to pellet the yeast.
Pour off the supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet.

steps.title: Wash Yeast Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the cell pellets three times using PBS.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 x g for 3-5 minutes.
Repeat the resuspension and centrifugation process three times.

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Extraction
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed cells in 1 mL PBS and transfer the mixture to a 15 mL conical centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Perform Lipid Extraction
steps.instruction: Add extraction solvents to the resuspended cells.

substeps.instruction: Add 3.75 mL of chloroform/methanol (1:2) to the 1 mL of resuspended cells.
Subsequently add 1.25 mL chloroform and 1.25 mL sterile water.

steps.title: Separate Lipid Phase
steps.instruction: Separate the organic lipid phase from the aqueous and protein layers.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 150 x g for 5 mins at room temperature.
Carefully remove the top aqueous layer and the middle insoluble layers (precipitated proteins).

steps.title: Dry and Weigh Lipids
steps.instruction: Dry the organic bottom layer and record the sample weight.

substeps.instruction: Dry the organic bottom layer using a speed vacuum or under a steady stream of nitrogen.
Record the weight of the dried sample by pre-weighing an Eppendorf tube or equivalent before or after drying.
